in_sanskrit.name: Baruni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born in the rainy season
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baruni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Baruni is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Barhana’ which means ‘to rain’. It is believed that girls named Baruni are born during the rainy season. In Hindu mythology, the rainy season is considered auspicious and is believed to bring prosperity and happiness.
